17: package uk.gov.hmrc.softdrinksindustrylevy.models
18: 
19: import play.api.libs.json._
20: import scala.language.implicitConversions
21: 
22: /** Utility class for creating json formatters for enumerations.
23:   */
24: object EnumUtils {
25:   def enumReads[E <: Enumeration](`enum`: E): Reads[`enum`.Value] = new Reads[`enum`.Value] {
26:     def reads(json: JsValue): JsResult[`enum`.Value] = json match {
27:       case JsString(s) if `enum`.values.exists(_.toString == s) => JsSuccess(`enum`.withName(s))
28:       case JsString(s) =>
29:         JsError(
30:           s"Enumeration expected of type: '${`enum`.getClass}'," ++
31:             s" but it does not appear to contain the value: '$s'"
32:         )
33:       case _ => JsError("String value expected")
34:     }
35:   }
36: 
37:   implicit def enumWrites[E <: Enumeration](`enum`: E): Writes[`enum`.Value] = new Writes[`enum`.Value] {
38:     def writes(v: `enum`.Value): JsValue = JsString(v.toString)
39:   }
40: 
41:   implicit def enumFormat[E <: Enumeration](`enum`: E): Format[`enum`.Value] =
42:     Format(enumReads(`enum`), enumWrites(`enum`))
43: 
44: }
